title: AI Agents in CI/CD:
main_point: The lecture studies delegated authority: models propose actions, while the surrounding system decides what may happen.
cues: Open with your name and role, then frame the problem as delegated authority.
A model proposes; the workflow grants authority and checks evidence.
Name the arc: foundations, security boundaries, robustness, measurement, and research questions.
Ask students to separate proved properties, measured observations, and design recommendations.
qualification: Operational limits bound attempts; useful completion and effect safety require separate evidence.
transition: Here is the route from foundations to the evidence needed to operate these systems.

article_section.title: Start with the agent loop

title: Lecture Outline
main_point: Each section adds one obligation needed before a probabilistic worker can safely participate in CI/CD.
cues: Foundations identify the principal, deputy, delegated objective, and authority.
Security asks what can be enforced when content and model output remain untrusted.
Robustness examines retries, feedback, state, and ambiguous external effects.
Measurement asks whether accepted work improves outcomes after review, failure, and downstream cost.
qualification: Keep three questions active: what is constrained, which assumptions support it, and what evidence could falsify the claim?
transition: Begin with a trace of observation, proposed action, tool result, and repetition.

article_section.title: Specify the system before claiming a guarantee

title: Agent Architecture: From Theory to Tool-Use LLMs
main_point: Assurance starts by separating what the model proposes from what the environment actually executes.
cues: Represent a run as observations, requested actions, tool results, and updated state.
Use the Universal Turing Machine comparison only as an analogy for unrestricted general computation.
A finite attempt budget proves at most that the counted attempts cannot exceed the bound.
Add wall-clock cancellation and explicit terminal states: accepted, failed, exhausted, or handed off.
qualification: Turing's result limits a general decider for arbitrary programs; it does not forbid checking a bounded workflow or stopping a particular run.
transition: Once the model can request effects, ask whose authority it exercises.

article_section.title: Specify the system before claiming a guarantee

title: The “Principal-Agent” Problem in AI Automation
main_point: Delegation quality depends on both the task class and the workflow that monitors and limits it.
cues: Name the organization as principal and the tool-using model as delegated worker.
Incomplete observability raises review cost because the final diff hides much intermediate reasoning.
Estimate success probability, verification effort, consequence, and reversibility by task class.
Treat prompts, schemas, gates, and telemetry as different behavior-shaping or monitoring mechanisms.
qualification: The economic language is an analogy: an LLM has no contractual incentives or personal exposure to downstream costs.
transition: The confused deputy gives a more precise account of authority misuse.

article_section.title: Treat tool use as delegated authority

title: The Confused Deputy Revisited
main_point: Hardy (1988): a caller used the compiler’s extra permissions to overwrite a billing file they could not write themselves.
cues: Setup: the compiler recorded usage statistics in (SYSX)STAT, so it had write access across SYSX.
Redirection: the caller named (SYSX)BILL as debugging output. The compiler overwrote billing data using its own authority.
Confusion: the caller chose the destination; the compiler supplied unrelated privileges. It mixed two sources of authority.
Capability fix: use a dedicated STAT capability and a caller-provided output capability, each naming its authorized file.
qualification: AI parallel: untrusted issue text chooses a target while the agent’s broad credential supplies authority.
transition: Prompt injection is one route by which untrusted content can misdirect the deputy.

article_section.title: Treat tool use as delegated authority

title: Injection Attack Taxonomy: Why Prompt Injection is Different
main_point: Prompt injection is an integrity problem at the language layer and an authority problem when interpreted text can cause effects.
cues: SQL parameters, context-aware web encoding, and shell avoidance each protect a defined syntactic boundary.
Current agents often process policy, user intent, retrieved text, and tool output through one language mechanism.
AgentDojo version 3 spans 97 user tasks and 629 eligible task-goal pairs, measuring utility with attack success.
CaMeL evaluates 949 expanded attacks using separated planning, quarantined processing, capabilities, and data-flow policy.
qualification: Benchmark resistance is distribution-specific; effect guarantees remain conditional on correct policy, annotations, mediation, and trusted components.
transition: Make those conditions visible by drawing identity, provenance, authority, and lifecycle boundaries.

article_section.title: State the threat model before reporting a rate

title: Trust Boundary Analysis
main_point: Identity, content provenance, authority, and evidence lifetime answer different trust questions and must remain separate.
cues: A verified maintainer can paste hostile external text; identity does not sanitize content.
Treat ticket bodies, repository files, logs, and model output as evidence with provenance.
Grant only the effects required for the named repository, branch, task, and time window.
Recheck eligibility and bind approval to the exact candidate revision before execution.
qualification: Email-domain or changelog checks are meaningful only when the tracker supplies authenticated canonical identity and controlled audit semantics.
transition: Place explicit gates before execution and again before an artifact is accepted.

article_section.title: Treat tool use as delegated authority

title: Case Study: Defense in Depth in Production
main_point: A gate should expose a versioned predicate, verdict, evidence record, and accountable owner at a named boundary.
cues: Pre-gates control admission and quarantine content before the model receives a task.
Post-gates bind sensitive-path, secret, identity, and ticket checks to the candidate artifact.
Several veto gates compose as conjunction for acceptance, without implying independent errors or complete coverage.
Detectors lower risk for configured patterns; quarantine and review limit consequences after uncertain verdicts.
qualification: Several gates can share a blind spot. A secret scanner is a detector, not proof of absence.
transition: Gates inspect named predicates; runtime containment limits which resources the worker can reach.

article_section.title: Build several enforcement boundaries

title: Containment Primitives: Kernel-Level Enforcement
main_point: Containment is a composition of controls, each mediating a specific operation under deployment assumptions.
cues: Landlock restricts ambient filesystem rights, with behavior dependent on kernel support, ABI, and handled operations.
Seccomp filters system calls and selected arguments, reducing kernel surface within a larger isolation design.
Network namespaces force traffic through a path where destination and application policy can be applied.
Test complete mediation, tamper resistance, alternate helpers, and failure behavior for the deployed composition.
qualification: Kernel placement alone proves neither complete mediation nor overall sandbox security; allowed channels and configuration remain part of authority.
transition: OpenShell shows one concrete composition and the limits of turning product behavior into a security claim.

article_section.title: Build several enforcement boundaries

title: Case Study: Sandboxing in Production
main_point: OpenShell combines job isolation, filesystem controls, network policy, and credential routing, but each property is version-specific.
cues: Public Agentic CI documentation supports an embedded gateway, Landlock controls, and endpoint policy.
Current OpenShell documentation describes network namespaces, a policy proxy, seccomp, and privilege dropping.
Credential handling differs by class: routed inference can retain provider keys at the host-side gateway.
A denied CONNECT currently returns a structured 403, so do not narrate every denial as a silent drop.
qualification: Allowed destinations still permit misuse. Neither a silent drop nor a proxy denial rules out side channels.
transition: Containment can deny an operation, but it cannot decide every semantic property of generated code.

article_section.title: Build several enforcement boundaries

title: The Oracle Problem: Limits of Output Verification
main_point: Verification claims become useful only after defining the property, observation surface, enforcement power, and assumptions.
cues: Rice concerns nontrivial extensional properties of arbitrary programs in a Turing-complete model.
Syntactic checks, types, bounded executions, finite models, and restricted contracts can remain decidable.
Safety violations have finite bad prefixes that a sufficiently powerful monitor may suppress before execution.
Liveness, such as eventually producing an acceptable patch, cannot generally be forced by stopping bad actions.
qualification: A bounded model check proves only the modeled property under a justified bound or completeness argument; real-system conformance remains separate.
transition: Retry behavior tests these boundaries because the same logical operation may be attempted again.

article_section.title: Give acceptance authority to evidence

title: Non-Determinism in Agentic Systems
main_point: Safe retry requires knowledge about the external effect, not confidence that a second sample will be better.
cues: CI already varies through clocks, networks, concurrency, mutable dependencies, and worker environments.
Agentic CI adds variation in diagnosis and patch selection; temperature zero is not a universal reproducibility guarantee.
Separate repeatable predicates, idempotent logical operations, and retries known safe after partial failure.
Use stable operation keys and bind evidence to source, candidate, tool, and policy versions.
qualification: A JSON schema validates shape, not truth, authorization, current state, or whether an external effect already occurred.
transition: When retries consume their own results, the workflow becomes a feedback system.

article_section.title: Recover effects using evidence, not the model’s recollection

title: Convergence and Divergence in Feedback Loops
main_point: Terminality, bounded attempts, convergence, and semantic improvement are four different properties.
cues: A fixed point requires an explicit transition function whose next state equals the current state.
Passing tests and approval define acceptance, but rerunning a stochastic agent may still change the patch.
A decreasing retry counter proves bounded attempts, not decreasing semantic error or useful completion.
Persist accepted, rejected, failed, exhausted, needs-human, and unknown states outside model prose.
qualification: Runtime shielding is correct only relative to its temporal specification, environment abstraction, available safe action, and mediated actuator set.
transition: A self-healing cycle shows why one local exclusion rule is useful but does not prove global acyclicity.

article_section.title: Prove a bound on attempts, then examine what it leaves open

title: Case Study: Cycle Detection in Self-Healing CI
main_point: Cycle prevention requires an invariant over every trigger edge, not confidence in one label name.
cues: An analyzer can create work selected by a fixer, whose failure creates new analyzer input.
Applying an exclusion label at creation removes one selection edge under the current admission rule.
Protect origin lineage, restrict who can change it, and recheck the predicate when the action commits.
A DAG proof needs the complete graph and a rank that strictly increases along every transition.
qualification: One exclusion rule removes one path; every alternate trigger and lineage reset must respect the invariant.
transition: Instructions can influence a proposed edge, while policy must remove disallowed edges from execution.

article_section.title: Turn the agent loop into a bounded workflow

title: Action Space Reduction via Skills
main_point: Skills structure model behavior, while independent runtime controls determine the executable action and effect space.
cues: A skill names procedure, inputs, output fields, stopping rules, and expected evidence.
It can concentrate model proposals without removing a tool call that the runtime still permits.
Separate possible proposals, exposed tools, state-dependent policy, and provider effects reachable through all paths.
Validate referenced objects, revisions, evidence, and policy before mapping a structured verdict to authority.
qualification: The type-system analogy applies only when declarations are independently checked and invalid transitions are refused.
transition: The same distinction between apparent structure and accepted effect determines what productivity metrics mean.

article_section.title: Turn the agent loop into a bounded workflow

title: Measuring AI Agent Productivity
main_point: Evaluate the complete assisted workflow against a defined counterfactual, including failure and human effort.
cues: Register eligible tasks before assignment; retain accepted, revised, rejected, abandoned, blocked, and unresolved outcomes.
Randomize when feasible; matching alone leaves task choice, familiarity, maturity, and urgency as possible confounders.
Sum model, CI, diagnosis, review, rework, and downstream costs across every attempt exactly once.
Divide cohort cost by accepted outcomes, while reporting human hours and the terminal-outcome distribution separately.
qualification: METR's 2025 result and randomized 2026 follow-up concern narrow study populations; selection and measurement changes limit transfer to current CI workflows.
transition: Review time is both a cost and a behavior that automation can change.

article_section.title: Estimate productivity with an explicit counterfactual

title: Automation Bias and Over-Reliance
main_point: Human review quality is an empirical outcome shaped by information order, workload, verification cost, and trust in automation.
cues: Separate omission errors after missing warnings from commission errors that follow incorrect advice.
Give reviewers the diff, bound revisions, commands, policy evidence, and unresolved gaps before a verdict.
Test whether showing the model verdict before independent assessment changes detection or confidence calibration.
Evaluate alert suppression through precision, recall, review time, and consequential defect detection.
qualification: Existing automation-bias literature motivates a CI hypothesis; it does not prove that better agents necessarily cause worse code review.
transition: This turns human involvement into an authority and information-flow design rather than a slogan.

article_section.title: Give acceptance authority to evidence

title: Human-in-the-Loop as Supervisory Control
main_point: Supervisory control is useful when consequence and semantic uncertainty exceed what automated evidence can justify.
cues: Map repository and pipeline to plant, checks to sensors, agent to controller, and tool APIs to actuators.
A supervisor may switch from the advanced controller to denial, staging, rollback preparation, or handoff.
Approval becomes a hard gate only when bound to the exact head and unavoidable by the agent.
Ask whether state, sensors, transition model, and safe fallback are faithful enough for the claimed envelope.
qualification: Stochasticity does not prove that no Lyapunov function exists, and theory does not require a human for every low-consequence action.
transition: Production observations should now be read as evidence under exposure, not as proof of the controls.

article_section.title: Supervisory control requires a specified model

title: Production Evidence at Scale
main_point: Operational counts establish activity and exposure, while causal benefit and safety require denominators, definitions, and detection coverage.
cues: 100+ MRs per week: activity volume; acceptance, rework, and value need their own evidence.
7 workflows, 15+ projects, 5 engineers: scope and exposure in the displayed snapshot.
Zero observed incidents: ask about the time window, incident definition, and detection coverage.
An observed outcome does not identify which control caused it or establish future risk.
qualification: Treat these as the slide’s dated snapshot, not a causal estimate or a current universal result.
transition: The distance between those observations and desired guarantees defines the research agenda.

article_section.title: Quantify uncertainty without manufacturing precision

title: Open Research Problems
main_point: Turn broad safety topics into experiments with explicit systems, adversaries, properties, and failure criteria.
cues: Model typed effects and verify candidate-bound approval or at-most-one-effect properties under injected crashes.
Compare injection defenses on eligible pairs, separating useful completion, prohibited effects, and text-only corruption.
Audit model-proposed capability manifests against deterministic policy for excess grants and blocked legitimate work.
Test ambiguous timeouts where no commit and committed-with-lost-response yield the same local observation.
qualification: The timeout argument is a synthesis under a stated observation model, not a universal impossibility theorem; stronger provider information can resolve ambiguity.
transition: Close by converting each research lesson into one implementable obligation.

article_section.title: Research problems hidden inside the workflow

title: Key Takeaways
main_point: Reliable agentic CI comes from bounded authority, explicit state, independently checked evidence, and decision-relevant measurement.
cues: Prevent confused-deputy failures by connecting every request to narrow, current authority.
Combine measured resistance to hostile text with enforced limits on data and tool effects.
Treat retries statistically, but retain deterministic checks for the exact predicates they encode.
Expand authority only after accepted value exceeds review, rework, failure, and downstream cost.
qualification: Every assurance statement must name its property, observation surface, enforcement point, trusted components, and remaining exclusions.
transition: Use the remaining time to test those assumptions against the audience's questions.

article_section.title: Research problems hidden inside the workflow

title: Questions?
main_point: Use questions to clarify which guarantee is behavioral, architectural, empirical, or still an open research hypothesis.
cues: Second LLM? Another measured detector; shared models and data can create correlated blind spots.
Read-only useful? Yes for analysis and review; grant writes only when the workflow requires them.
Timeout after PR creation? Query stable operation state, then retry only with idempotency or known non-application.
Strongest claim? A named broker blocks a defined finite bad prefix under stated mediation and conformance assumptions.
qualification: Human review adds context and accountability but is not an oracle; scope retained authority by consequence, reversibility, and measured residual risk.
transition: Return to the central question: what exact effect can this system justify under its stated evidence?
